lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaste, main Kaveri Finance se bol raha hoon. Kya meri baat Rohit Verma ji se ho rahi hai?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ, मैं रोहित बोल रहा हूँ। बताइए।
lines.roman: Haan, main Rohit bol raha hoon. Bataiye.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir. Just to inform you, this call is being recorded for quality purposes. Verification ke liye, kya aap apne loan account ke last four digits bata sakte hain?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you Rohit ji. Aapka personal loan ka EMI, eight thousand four hundred rupees, jo fifth November ko due tha, abhi tak pending hai.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ मुझे पता है। इस बार salary late आई है, company में कुछ issue चल रहा था।
lines.roman: Haan mujhe pata hai. Is baar salary late aayi hai, company mein kuch issue chal raha tha.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Main samajh sakta hoon sir, aisa kabhi kabhi ho jata hai. Kya aapko andaza hai salary kab tak credit hogi?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: अगले हफ्ते तक आ जानी चाहिए, शायद बीस तारीख तक।
lines.roman: Agle hafte tak aa jaani chahiye, shayad bees taarikh tak.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay. Just so you are aware, after the grace period a late fee of five hundred rupees applies, and timely payment keeps your credit score healthy.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ठीक है, मैं बीस तारीख को पूरा EMI भर दूँगा।
lines.roman: Theek hai, main bees taarikh ko poora EMI bhar doonga.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Bahut badhiya. Aap payment kaise karna chahenge, UPI se ya main aapko payment link bhej doon?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Link भेज दीजिए, UPI से कर दूँगा।
lines.roman: Link bhej dijiye, UPI se kar doonga.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure sir. So to confirm, eight thousand four hundred rupees on twentieth November through the payment link, which I am sending to your registered number now.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaad Rohit ji, aapka din shubh ho.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer committed to paying the full EMI of ₹8,400 on 20 November via the payment link.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed the November EMI because his salary was delayed. Agent verified identity, stated dues, explained the late fee factually, and secured a dated promise-to-pay with a payment link.
analysis.observations: Textbook early-bucket call: verification and recording disclosure up front, empathetic acknowledgement before negotiating, and a clear recap at the end.
analysis.improvements: Could confirm the registered mobile number before sending the link.

op_greet_company.rationale: Agent greeted and named Kaveri Finance in the first line.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for the last four digits of the loan account before discussing dues.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Explicitly stated that the call is recorded.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated ₹8,400 EMI and the 5 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Mentioned the ₹500 late fee and credit score impact factually.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked when the salary would be credited after the customer mentioned the delay.

ds_empathy.rationale: Acknowledged that such delays happen before moving on.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Loan discussed only after the borrower confirmed his identity.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer promised the full EMI on the 20th.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: Payment via link using UPI confirmed.

cl_recap.rationale: Agent repeated amount, date and mode before closing.
